- **B-01 Auth on mutations:** Repository behält `getAuthenticatedUserId()` + `.eq('owner_user_id', userId)` — unchanged.

- **B-08 Server-side authz:** Character CRUD owner-scoped in repository — unchanged.
- **F-03 Input validation:** Normalization/validation in use-cases preserved — unchanged semantics.
